findings.section: Resume success and observable boundary remain underspecified
findings.evidence: D5 chooses a discontinuity and a first PHI2 fetch but VICE_OBS exposes read/write/idle/dummy, not an opcode-fetch tag. mainc64cpu.c lines 359-362 permits stolen cycles before the load. The plan names a constrained positive case without stating its interrupt/BA/idle preconditions or first-read rule. R11 line 57 claims its MAINCPU read failure makes a later-module failure observable, yet c64-snapshot.c calls MAINCPU at 121 before CIA and other readers; a later failure follows a successful MAINCPU return and then resets at 146-153.
findings.rationale: A CPU-module resume record proves the loaded CPU fields, not successful complete snapshot restoration. The new predicates still lack a defined discriminator for the required idle/stolen/interrupt cases and a complete-load outcome. Reusing an earlier clock value also need not make an ordered marker ambiguous.
findings.correction: D1 must define the constrained fixture/state preconditions and observable record ordering; D5 must prove the same positive and negative cases on real traces, including idle/stolen first gates, pending interrupt, reused clock, unrelated reset and failure after MAINCPU succeeds. Define full-load success independently of a CPU-module success record; preserve complete AC1 resume/round-trip semantics.

findings.section: R10 does not establish the broader reader-safety claim
findings.evidence: Pinned drive-snapshot.c line 315 leaves rotation_table_ptr uninitialized; absent/TDE-off units bypass its assignment at 394, but line 433 unconditionally passes the array to rotation_table_set. rotation.c lines 189-203 reads each entry at 194 regardless of DriveType, then overwrites speed_zone at 203. Type NONE protects the three clock assignments, not this source read.
findings.rationale: The source contradicts the broad statement that no uninitialized value is read. The overwritten store may be optimized away in a particular binary; this review did not compile or execute native code and does not claim observed corruption. Executable impact and a portable safety disposition remain unproved.
findings.correction: Before any affected real load, D1 must resolve the entire pinned reader path and retain both-host executable/source evidence or an approved external disposition. Keep VICE immutable and the required fixture approved; do not assume three skipped assignments establish whole-reader safety.

findings.evidence: Pinned mos6510.h lines 116-136 splits N and Z from raw p and recomposes architectural P through MOS6510_REGS_GET_STATUS. The required fixture has P=A0. Successful read populates the globals on both machines, and the call is cross-object; the proposed seam is feasible.
findings.rationale: An explicit status-byte and forwarding control prevents an otherwise plausible raw-field implementation from losing flags. This strengthens the chosen R11 B design without rejecting it.
findings.correction: D1 mock tests must reconstruct architectural P, cover N/Z/unused-bit combinations, wide clock and PC, call the real reader exactly once, preserve return/state, emit no resume on read failure and handle stderr write/flush failure. D5 binds these tests and no-snapshot gate/PNG equivalence to both hosts.

findings.evidence: drive-resources.c set_drive_type detaches images and sets unit type/bus state; drive_disable changes enabled/port state. iecbus.c lines 493-547 makes bus routing depend on resource state. With TDE off, drive-type bit alone does not select true-drive routing, but resource changes still occur. A TDE-on module with has_drives=0 also bypasses per-drive initialization.
findings.rationale: The approved precondition has effects beyond bypassing a copy. Its permitted workload/context and invalid DRIVE payload behavior should have explicit observable outcomes rather than an assumed universal equivalence.
findings.correction: D1 rejects truncated/invalid has_tde/has_drives payloads before launch and proves required NONE flags cannot be overridden. D5 records effective resources/media and demonstrates the approved workload continuation and media context under the precondition on both hosts, or reports a blocker requiring an explicit requirement disposition.

findings.evidence: R6 explicitly requires transitive enumeration but its named controls cover a direct plain Fact and a string-only mention. Actual tests use helpers/providers and IViceNative also represents an interface usable by managed fakes.
findings.rationale: A helper-only positive control and pure-managed fake negative control make the authorized denominator mechanically distinguishable.
findings.correction: D0 mocks must find a test whose only path is test to helper/provider to shim, and retain a managed fake IViceNative case with no native load. D2 proves the same method-ID selection and both-library zero-load evidence without broad file/class exclusion.

findings.evidence: The supplied legacy clock is 109163946; -autostart first performs a reboot/delay. The proposed command leaves -limitcycles <n> unspecified. maincpu_clk_limit is compared to absolute maincpu_clk, while the observer requires gate acknowledgments throughout the prelude and resumed interval.
findings.rationale: A short absolute limit can stop before the deferred load or immediately after a large restored clock. A passing short prefix must not stand in for the required complete post-resume comparison interval.
findings.correction: D1 defines the exact cycle budget/window and input acknowledgment protocol. D5 retains a nonempty expected post-load interval and rejects prelude-only exit, early termination, missing/extra/reordered half-cycles and a truncated round-trip baseline on both hosts; include restored clocks above the initial launch budget.

accuracyRationale: 94: Counts, hunk classification, restore safeguards and the cross-object register seam are supported. The complete-obligation claim, resolver-logging assumption, exact-known-red assumption and later-module failure claim remain inaccurate.
completenessRationale: 89: Missing preserved Slice 1 details, the D2/Phase E comparator dependency, the original XMLDoc/task obligation, incomplete resume boundary and unproved whole-reader safety still prevent execution readiness. Scores are holistic judgments, not ratios of finding counts.
evidenceScope: Read-only repository/source inspection and supported primary MCP reads/writes for this review. No managed/native tests, full-solution/native build, nested reviewer, native restoration, commit or push was run.
